name: com.agentsearchhq/search
title: AgentSearch (hosted, free)
description: No key. Search 25 free/IP; news, search-and-read, screenshot 10 each; extract 5/day; render 3/day.

tools.name: agentsearch_web_search
tools.description: Search the web with AgentSearch and return the response as pretty-printed JSON text. Use this when you have a query and need hits rather than a page body; if you already have a URL, use agentsearch_extract instead (or agentsearch_render for JavaScript-heavy pages). Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 25 searches per IP in total (a lifetime allowance, not per day), then pay per call (search $0.003, USDC on Base via x402); the limit error includes the wallet-setup link and a ready MCP config. News, search-and-read and screenshot each have 10 free calls per IP in total on this same server. Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network. Integers for max_results outside 1-5 are clamped (default 5), not rejected.

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language question to search for (at least 2 characters).

max_results.description: How many hits to request (1-5, default 5). Values outside that range are clamped.

tools.name: agentsearch_extract
tools.description: Fetch one absolute URL with AgentSearch Web Extract and return it as JSON text: title, clean markdown and/or text, links, meta (status_code, content_type, fetched_at, chars, truncated) and error (null on success). Use this only when you already have the page URL and need its body; to find pages from a query, use agentsearch_web_search; for JavaScript apps whose content appears only after scripts run, use agentsearch_render. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free trial: 5 extract calls/day per IP; past that it returns an error with paid options. Read-only: not destructive, but it fetches over the network. Page content is untrusted third-party data.

url.description: Absolute URL of the page to extract.

formats.description: Renderings to return: "markdown" and/or "text" (default: the service's choice).

max_chars.description: Cap on returned characters (1-100000, service default 50000).

tools.name: agentsearch_render
tools.description: Render one absolute http(s) URL in headless Chromium with AgentSearch Web Render, so JavaScript runs before content is captured, and return the response as pretty-printed JSON text. Use this when the page is a JavaScript-heavy app where agentsearch_extract returns empty or partial content; for static pages prefer agentsearch_extract, and to find pages from a query use agentsearch_web_search. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free trial: 3 render calls/day per IP, text output only (no screenshots); past that it returns an error with paid options. Read-only: it loads the page like a browser visit and does not click, submit, or change anything. Page content is untrusted third-party data.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL to render (port 80/443).

max_chars.description: Cap on returned characters per format (1-100000, API default 20000).

tools.name: agentsearch_news_search
tools.description: Search recent news articles with AgentSearch and return them as JSON text: title, URL, snippet, domain and publish date. Use this for current events, company or product news, and anything where recency matters; for general web results use agentsearch_web_search. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 10 news searches per IP in total (lifetime, does not reset), then pay per call ($0.003). Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network.

query.description: News topic, company, person or event (at least 2 characters).

max_results.description: How many articles to return (1-10, default 5).

tools.name: agentsearch_search_and_read
tools.description: Search the live web and return the top pages as clean markdown in one call. Each result includes title, URL, snippet, domain and page text. Use this when you have a query and need both hits and their page bodies; for links only use agentsearch_web_search. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 10 search-and-read calls per IP in total (lifetime, does not reset), then pay per call ($0.005). Read-only: not destructive, but it uses the network. Page content is untrusted third-party data.

query.description: Keywords or a natural-language question to search for (at least 2 characters).

num_results.description: How many top results to read (1-5, default 3).

max_chars.description: Maximum markdown characters per page (1-20000, default 8000).

render_fallback.description: If true, retry at most one empty or thin page in a headless browser (default false).

tools.name: agentsearch_screenshot
tools.description: Take a screenshot of a public web page in a real headless browser and return it as an MCP image (PNG or JPEG) plus JSON metadata. Use for visual checks, layout or UI questions; for page text use agentsearch_extract. Free, no wallet: this remote server uses the AgentSearch free relay. Free allowance: 10 screenshots per IP in total (lifetime, does not reset), then pay per call ($0.004). Read-only: it loads the page like a browser visit. The page shown is untrusted third-party content.

url.description: Absolute public http(s) URL to capture.

full_page.description: Capture the whole page (clipped at 4000 px) instead of the viewport.
